title: Thumb-scrubbed page peel back navigation
blurb: Two live HTML app screens stacked inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas. Drag from a 28 px inset left gutter to curl the detail screen round a 3D cylinder, revealing the inbox underneath with parallax, a shaded cream underside and spring cancellation.
question: Can I pair a safe inset gesture gutter with a GPU 3D cylinder page-peel shader over two live drawable app screens so scrubbing back reveals the underlying live page with parallax, shaded fold curl and mid-swipe spring cancellation?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas uploads both drawable views via texElementSubImage2D(), curls the detail view round a 3D cylinder from an inset 28 px gutter, glides the inbox underneath with -24% to 0% parallax, and updates updateElementGeometry() plus inert as views settle.
